Confluence over 8 weeks bear vs bull
Four rungs, and you only act on the top one. STAND DOWN, nothing is on. WATCH, one or two signals are true but they stand alone. SETUP, several are lining up. ACT, three of them have held for three sessions and they come from three different families, so it is not the same idea counted three times. A signal only counts once it has held three sessions, because one day in the zone is noise. Signals our lab rejected are left out of the count.
The three counts: firing = the condition is true at today's close, confirmed = it has been true 3 sessions in a row (this is what the bar counts), building = not true yet but close.
How to read each row: every signal is a checklist. Most of them need several things to be true at the same moment, so each line shows the condition, where it stands now and what it needs. A signal fires only when every box is ticked, which is why a number can sit well past its own trigger while the row still reads BUILDING. Some signals have two paths, either one arms them. ALERT (red bear / green bull) = it just fired, BUILDING = getting close, QUIET = nothing here yet. Widening? tells you whether the divergence is still growing or easing back. This watches high-yield credit moving in lockstep with stocks while HYG itself is bleeding, the setup where credit stops being a cushion and starts confirming equity downside. HYG falling over ten sessions is in place; the 30-day correlation of HYG and SPX is still missing.

For it to fire you need that correlation to stay pinned high while HYG keeps leaking, which rules out the benign case where credit just trades on its own factors. The correlation framing itself is untested in our lab, but the underlying credit stress is valid via the separate HYG drawdown row, so read this as corroborating evidence when it lines up.

This watches tail-hedging demand going vertical, either on the raw SKEW print or on a fast 20-day z-score of it. The spot condition is in place with SKEW at or above the trigger level; the stretched z20 leg is still missing.

For the full composite you want both legs lit, which is the setup that actually paid in the lab: equity index down meaningfully over the following couple of months with a highly significant hit rate. If SKEW mean-reverts back below the trigger before the z-score catches up, the signal unwinds and you lose the tail-risk tell.

Kerberos said

"SKEW range 100-150, average 115. 140+ = deep OTM put demand, tail risk priced in. uncorrelated with VIX day to day."

The haven filter checks whether gold is holding up while high-yield credit and long bonds lose momentum, which is how you tell a real risk-off from a vol head-fake. Haven confirmation is in place and nothing is missing.

Statuses recompute nightly from the EOD pipeline. Confirmed = 3 consecutive sessions in zone (the framework buffer rule: one day in zone is noise).
